component.name: Sleeve
component.summary: Music library, player and sync dashboard

description.p: Sleeve browses your music library, plays it through mpv, and runs the playlist-sync downloader's sorting, genre repair, duplicate and playlist jobs from one window.

ul.li: Library browser with genre folders and instant search
Playback with queue, shuffle, repeat, cover art and synced lyrics
Playlist view that shows which songs are missing from the library
Library health report and a tag editor
